name: Choreograph
description:
[Wiki Page](https://wiki.roll20.net/Script:Choreograph)

Meta-sequencer for Roll20 tokens. Define scenes in handouts -- filter tokens, compute per-token timing, and fire commands at the right moments. Designed to orchestrate animations and effects across groups of tokens with spatial propagation, staggering, and parameterizable timing.

Requires: SelectManager.

Scenes are stored in [Scene] handouts, casts in [Cast] handouts.

**Features:**
- Interactive tutorial series (6 guided walkthroughs)
- Scene chaining and recursion with sync gating
- Cast system with named roles
- Parameters, variables, and full JS expression evaluation
- When column for conditional row execution
- Built-in FX commands (fx, fxbetween) with token ID support
- Extension API for other scripts to register functions, variables, hooks
- Signal system (onSceneStart/onSceneFinish)

Commands:
- `!choreograph run <name> [flags]` -- Execute a scene
- `!choreograph new <name>` -- Create blank scene handout
- `!choreograph list [query]` -- List scenes (fuzzy search)
- `!choreograph edit <name>` -- Open scene handout
- `!choreograph delete <name>` -- Delete a scene
- `!choreograph stop [name]` -- Stop running scene(s)
- `!choreograph pause [name]` -- Pause running scene(s)
- `!choreograph resume [name]` -- Resume paused scene(s)
- `!choreograph status` -- Show all running scenes
- `!choreograph fx <type> <id|x y> [id2|x2 y2]` -- Spawn FX (auto-detects point vs between)
- `!choreograph cast add/remove/list/show/delete` -- Manage casts

See the Help: Choreograph handout (generated on startup) for full documentation.
